exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
exercises.description: 90/90 Hip Switches is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hips, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, rotate your hips to drop both knees to one side, then sweep them smoothly to the other, keeping your chest proud as your hips roll through.

exercises.name: Ab Scissors
exercises.description: Ab Scissors is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie back, press your spine down, and alternate crossing your straight legs like scissors while keeping your core engaged.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel
exercises.description: Ab Wheel is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Start on your knees, roll the wheel forward while keeping your ribs down and hips in line, then pull back using your core without sagging.

exercises.name: Adductor Rockbacks
exercises.description: Adductor Rockbacks is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, adductors, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Set up on all fours with one leg extended out to the side, sit your hips back toward your heel, then glide forward again, feeling a deep, controlled stretch along your inner thigh.

exercises.name: Agility Ladder Run
exercises.description: A quick-footed drill through the ladder that sharpens coordination, acceleration, and precise foot placement in an athletic stance.
exercises.instructions: Stay on the balls of your feet, place one foot in each square, pump your arms, and move quickly through the ladder without letting your feet clip the edges.

exercises.name: Air Bike
exercises.description: A fan-bike effort using both arms and legs to drive the pedals and handles, delivering intense, full-body conditioning with every push.
exercises.instructions: Sit with a neutral spine, drive the pedals while powerfully pushing and pulling the handles, and use strong, full-body strokes while controlling your breathing pace.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
exercises.description: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, other, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Place your front foot flat with heel planted, drive your knee forward over your toes while keeping the heel down, then rock back and repeat to open the front of the ankle.

exercises.name: Arch Hold
exercises.description: Arch Hold is a core-focused position that teaches full-body tension and trunk stability, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your stomach, squeeze your glutes and upper back, then lift your chest, arms, and legs to create a smooth arch, holding steady without letting your ribs dump into the floor.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: A shoulder press using dumbbells or machine to build overhead strength and upper-body stability.
exercises.instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of your chest, palms facing you; as you press up, rotate your palms to face forward, finishing overhead before reversing the motion.

exercises.name: Around the world
exercises.description: A landmine press performed with one arm, combining a forward arc with torso rotation for strong, athletic shoulder power.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench holding the weights above your chest with a slight bend in your elbows; sweep your arms out wide in a circular arc until they're by your sides, then reverse the motion back overhead.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.description: A supported dip using a machine or band, allowing you to groove the movement pattern and build chest and triceps strength safely.
exercises.instructions: Use the assistance pad, lean forward slightly, and perform smooth dips while controlling your descent.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.description: A controlled hinge over a pad where you lift your torso upright, strengthening the lower back, glutes, and spinal stability.
exercises.instructions: Lock your hips on the pad, cross your arms or hold a plate, and lower your torso until it's just below neutral; drive your hips into the pad, squeeze your glutes, and rise until your body forms a straight line-no hyperextending.

exercises.name: Back Lever Hold
exercises.description: An advanced static hold where your body is parallel to the ground, testing unmatched core, back, and shoulder strength in a rigid line.
exercises.instructions: From a secure grip, lower your body until it's parallel to the ground, squeeze your glutes and core, and keep your body rigid in one straight line while you hold.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: A classic barbell squat resting on your upper back, building powerful legs, strong hips, and a resilient core.
exercises.instructions: Set the bar firmly on your upper back, grip it tight, and breathe deep into your belly; sit your hips back and down, keep your knees tracking over your toes, then drive up through mid-foot and heels to stand tall without collapsing your chest.

exercises.name: Band Pullaparts
exercises.description: A lateral arm lift that targets the side delts, creating shoulder width and strong, controlled arm mechanics.
exercises.instructions: Hold the band at chest height with straight but not locked elbows; pull your shoulder blades down and back as you stretch the band apart until it lightly touches your chest, then return with control.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocates
exercises.description: Banded Shoulder Dislocates is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Hold a light band wide in front of you, keep your elbows straight, and slowly raise it overhead and behind you, then return, moving only as far as you can without pain or shrugging.

exercises.name: Bar Muscle-Up
exercises.description: Bar Muscle-Up is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, full body while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Swing into a strong hollow-to-arch kip, then drive your hips to the bar as you pull, snapping your chest over the bar and pressing out to a solid top position.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.description: Explosive rope waves from a strong athletic stance that light up your shoulders, core, and legs while driving your heart rate high.
exercises.instructions: Drop into an athletic stance, brace your core, and whip the ropes with powerful alternating or double waves, keeping your shoulders down and chest lifted.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.description: Bear Crawl is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting full_body, full_body, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stay low with knees hovering off the floor, move opposite hand and foot forward, and keep your hips level and core tight as you crawl.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.description: A deep, upright squat performed with a vertical torso, targeting quads and mobility through ankles and hips.
exercises.instructions: Clip the belt at your hips, stand tall over the platform, and sit your hips straight down between your feet; let the weight pull your hips, not your back, then push through your mid-foot and heels to stand without yanking with your hands.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.description: A decline press emphasizing lower chest through a deep, strong pressing arc.
exercises.instructions: Place your hands on the bench behind you, fingers pointing forward, and walk your feet out; lower your body by bending your elbows straight back, keeping your chest lifted, then press through your palms to straighten your arms without locking out harshly.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.description: A foundational barbell press that builds raw chest, shoulder, and triceps strength for powerful upper-body performance.
exercises.instructions: Plant your feet, pull your shoulders back, lower the bar to mid-chest, and press up with control and full-body tension.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row
exercises.description: A classic hinged row that builds complete back thickness and strong pulling mechanics.
exercises.instructions: Take a hip-width stance, hinge at your hips until your torso is about 45 degrees or lower, and let the bar or dumbbells hang beneath your shoulders; pull the weight toward your midsection, squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return the weight slowly to the start.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
exercises.description: A hinged barbell row where you stay locked over the weight, building dense upper-back muscle, grip strength, and powerful pulls.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips with a flat back, let the bar hang under your shoulders, and brace your core; row the bar toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower until your arms are straight without letting your torso rise.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.description: Biceps Curl is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, biceps, arms, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, keep elbows close to your ribs, and curl the weight up by flexing your biceps without swinging.

exercises.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
exercises.description: Biceps Wall Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, biceps, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand beside a wall, place your palm flat with fingers pointing down or back, then gently turn your chest away until you feel a long stretch through the front of your arm and shoulder.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: Bicycle Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lift your shoulders, extend one leg, and rotate your torso to bring your opposite elbow toward your knee with controlled twists.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: Bird Dog is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: From all fours, extend opposite arm and leg, keeping your hips level and spine long before switching sides.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.description: Box Jump is a plyometric movement that trains fast, forceful extension through your hips, knees, and ankles, targeting squat, quads, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Dip into a quarter squat, swing your arms, and jump onto the box by driving through your hips, landing quietly with knees tracking forward and standing tall before stepping down.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.description: A squat to a box that teaches depth, control, and hip power while helping reinforce consistent squat mechanics.
exercises.instructions: Stand with the box behind you, sit back under control until you lightly touch the box without relaxing, then explode up by driving your feet through the floor; keep your shins mostly vertical and your torso tight throughout.

exercises.name: Box Step-Down
exercises.description: A lateral step-out squat building outer-hip strength, knee stability, and athletic side-to-side power.
exercises.instructions: Stand on the box, shift your weight onto the standing leg, and slowly lower the other heel toward the floor like a controlled single-leg squat; lightly tap or just hover your heel, then press through the standing leg to return to the top.

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
exercises.description: A powerful horizontal jump from a loaded stance that builds lower-body explosiveness, strong landings, and athletic jump mechanics.
exercises.instructions: Start in an athletic stance, swing your arms back as you load your hips, then explode forward like a long jumper, landing in a stable squat with knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: A rear-foot elevated split squat that amplifies the stretch and load on your front leg, building elite single-leg strength.
exercises.instructions: Place your back foot on a bench, shift your weight into the front heel, and lower your hips straight down; keep your chest lifted, knee tracking over your toes, and power up through the front leg without bouncing.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.description: A burpee that launches into a long forward jump, demanding explosive power, coordination, and full-body conditioning with every rep.
exercises.instructions: Drop into a burpee, pop your feet forward, then immediately swing your arms and launch into a long forward jump, landing softly in a partial squat before resetting for the next rep.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: A total-body conditioning move combining a squat, plank, push-up, and jump to build strength, power, and grit in one fluid pattern.
exercises.instructions: From standing, squat down to plant your hands, kick your feet back to a solid plank, snap them back under you, then explode up into a full jump with a strong reach overhead.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.description: A running-in-place drill where your heels kick toward your glutes, waking up your hamstrings and improving leg turnover and posture.
exercises.instructions: Jog in place, quickly pulling your heels up to tap your glutes, stay tall through your torso, and keep a light, quick rhythm with active arm drive.

exercises.name: Butterfly Pec Deck
exercises.description: A machine fly where your forearms press into pads, guiding your chest through a strict, high-tension arc for focused muscle work.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall, press your forearms against the pads, and bring them together by squeezing your chest without hunching.

exercises.name: Butterfly Sit-Up
exercises.description: Butterfly Sit-Up is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Butterfly your legs, reach overhead, then swing up smoothly, touching your toes while keeping your spine rounded naturally.

exercises.name: Cable Core Press
exercises.description: Cable Core Press is a pressing movement that builds driving force through your chest, shoulders, and arms, targeting abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand perpendicular to the cable, press the handle straight out, and resist rotation as you hold tension through your midsection.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Cable Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Kneel with the rope overhead, curl your spine into a strong crunch, and return slowly without letting the weight pull you up.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Cable Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Kneel with the rope overhead, curl your spine into a strong crunch, and return slowly without letting the weight pull you up.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: A standing curl against constant cable tension, keeping your biceps working hard through the entire range for smooth, controlled strength.
exercises.instructions: Stand with a solid stance, keep elbows tucked, and curl the handle toward your chest with steady resistance both up and down.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.description: A chest fly done on cables, keeping steady tension on your pecs from full stretch to full squeeze for smooth, sculpting reps.
exercises.instructions: Step forward, keep slight elbow bend, and draw your hands together in front of your chest using steady tension.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.description: A cable hip hinge where the weight travels between your legs, training your glutes and hamstrings to snap you tall with power.
exercises.instructions: Stand facing away from the cable with the rope between your legs, hinge at your hips with a flat back, and let your hands travel behind you; drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes at the top while keeping the rope close to your body.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.description: Cable Woodchop is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting rotation, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, pull the handle diagonally across your body using your core, and rotate your torso while keeping your arms long.

exercises.name: Calf Extension
exercises.description: A controlled, machine-based calf movement where you push through the balls of your feet to develop strong, springy ankles and calves.
exercises.instructions: Extend your ankles fully at the top and lower slowly to activate the full length of your calf muscles.

exercises.name: Calf Press
exercises.description: A heavy calf drive on a leg press machine, letting you load the calves safely for serious strength and size.
exercises.instructions: On the leg press, press with the balls of your feet, extend your ankles fully, and lower deep without letting your heels rest.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch
exercises.description: Calf Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, calves, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Place your toes on a raised edge or step with your heel dropped, keep your leg straight, and slowly shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch in your lower calf and Achilles.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.description: Cat-Cow is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, round your spine up toward the ceiling as you exhale, then slowly arch your back and lift your chest and tailbone as you inhale, moving smoothly between the two shapes.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description: A forward-leaning dip that loads your chest and triceps, building powerful pressing strength with your own bodyweight.
exercises.instructions: Lean slightly forward, lower until your elbows hit 90°, then press up strongly through your chest and triceps.

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.description: A wide-opening dumbbell movement that stretches and squeezes the chest, building shape and control through a big range of motion.
exercises.instructions: Open your arms wide with a soft bend, stretch your chest, then bring the weights together using a smooth arc.

exercises.name: Chest- Supported Row
exercises.description: A chest‑supported row eliminating momentum for clean, strict back activation.
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, let the weights or handles hang beneath you, and keep your neck neutral; pull the weight toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back, pause for a strong squeeze, then lower under control without bouncing off the stops.

exercises.name: Chest-to- Bar Pull-Up
exercises.description: Chest-to- Bar Pull-Up is a vertical pulling pattern that carves out your back and arms while demanding core control, targeting pull, lats, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: From a dead hang, pull your shoulder blades down and back, then drive your elbows toward your ribs to bring your chest firmly to the bar before lowering under control.

exercises.name: Chestsupported Incline Row
exercises.description: An incline‑supported row isolating lats and upper back through a controlled path.
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging straight down, draw your shoulders back, and then row the weights toward your lower chest; pause at the top to feel your mid-back working, then lower with control without letting your chest leave the pad.

exercises.name: Childs Pose with Side Reach
exercises.description: Childs Pose with Side Reach is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Sink your hips back toward your heels, walk your hands to one side, and reach long through your fingertips to open the side of your ribcage while breathing deeply.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.description: An underhand pull-up variation that highlights your biceps while still hammering the lats for strong, balanced upper-body pulling.
exercises.instructions: Grab the bar with an underhand grip, set your shoulders down and back, and brace your core; pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down in front of you, pause at the top, then lower in a smooth, controlled descent.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description: An underhand bodyweight pull where you bring your chest toward the bar, building big lats and biceps with every rep.
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip, squeeze your glutes and brace your core, and pull your shoulders down away from your ears; drive your elbows toward your ribs to lift your chest to the bar, hold briefly, then lower with full control.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.description: A side-lying hip opener where you rotate your top knee up, strengthening the outer glutes that stabilize your knees and pelvis.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent, keep your feet stacked, and brace your core; open your top knee like a clamshell without rolling your pelvis back, pause at the top to feel the outer hip working, then close slowly.

exercises.name: Clean
exercises.description: A classic Olympic lift that brings the weight from floor to front rack with a strong pull and squat, building powerful legs and hips.
exercises.instructions: Drive through the floor with a tall chest, let the bar brush up your thighs, then whip your elbows quickly around to catch it high on your shoulders in a strong front-rack position.

exercises.name: Cleanand Jerk
exercises.description: A clean followed by a powerful overhead jerk, training you to transfer leg drive into a stable, locked-out overhead position.
exercises.instructions: Clean the bar to a solid front rack, dip straight down, then drive it overhead as you split your feet front and back, catching with bent knees before stepping your feet together.

exercises.name: Cleanand Press
exercises.description: An explosive lift that pulls the weight from the floor to the shoulders, then presses it overhead to build total-body strength and power.
exercises.instructions: Pull the weight close to your body as you drive through your legs to bring it to your shoulders, then squeeze your glutes and press it straight overhead with a stable core.

exercises.name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A narrow-grip pulldown that targets the lower lats and mid-back, adding depth and power down the center of your back.
exercises.instructions: Take a narrow grip or V-bar, sit tall, and keep your chest lifted; pull the handle down toward your upper chest while tucking your elbows close to your sides, squeezing your lats, then extend your arms slowly for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Close Grip Push-up
exercises.description: A tighter-hand push-up variation that hammers your triceps and teaches you to keep elbows close for powerful, efficient pressing.
exercises.instructions: Bring your hands close, keep elbows tucked, and drive upward through your triceps with a strong plank body.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: A close‑grip bench press emphasizing triceps drive while supporting chest strength.
exercises.instructions: Lie on the bench with your hands just inside shoulder-width on the bar, pin your shoulder blades back, and plant your feet; lower the bar under control toward your lower chest or upper ribs, keeping your elbows close to your sides, then press the bar back up by driving through your triceps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.description: A narrow-hand push-up that shifts the work to your triceps and inner chest, building pressing power with just your bodyweight.
exercises.instructions: Place hands shoulder-width or narrower, lower your chest between your hands, and press up powerfully using your triceps.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: A seated curl where you lock your elbow against your leg, zeroing in on the biceps for focused, high-tension reps.
exercises.instructions: Sit forward, brace your elbow inside your thigh, and curl the weight straight up while focusing hard on biceps engagement.

exercises.name: Corerotation
exercises.description: Corerotation is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand athletic, hold a band or weight, and rotate your torso while keeping your hips square and your core braced.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance leg press emphasizing inner thighs and glutes while promoting strong hip drive.
exercises.instructions: Stand wide, turn one foot slightly out, and sink your hips down over that leg while keeping the other leg straight; keep your heel planted and chest tall, then use your inner thigh and glutes to pull yourself back to the middle.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.description: Couch Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hips, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Place one shin up against a wall or bench with your knee down and opposite foot forward, then gradually bring your torso upright, squeezing your glutes to open the front of your hip and thigh.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
exercises.description: A reverse, hips-up crawl that strengthens shoulders, triceps, and posterior chain while challenging coordination and core control.
exercises.instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet planted, lift your hips off the floor, and step opposite hand and foot forward while keeping your chest open and hips elevated.

exercises.name: Crossbody Hammer Curl
exercises.description: A controlled biceps curl where you drive the dumbbell across your body, building thick biceps and forearms with a powerful cross-body path.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, keep your elbow pinned, and curl the dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder while squeezing your biceps through the top.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, ribs down, lift your shoulders by shortening your abs-not pulling your neck-and lower with control.

exercises.name: Cuban Press
exercises.description: A technical shoulder drill that combines external rotation and pressing to strengthen your rotator cuff and protect the shoulders under load.
exercises.instructions: Lift the weights to shoulder height, externally rotate to overhead position, then press up with smooth, controlled motion.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.description: A deep knee-flexion drill sliding your shins forward, strengthening quads and knee tendons through a long range of motion.
exercises.instructions: Step one leg diagonally behind the other as if you're performing a curtsy, bend both knees, and sink your hips down; keep your front knee tracking over your toes, then push through the front heel to return to a strong, upright stance.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.description: A smooth pedaling motion that targets your legs and lungs while keeping impact low, perfect for building cardiovascular endurance.
exercises.instructions: Sit with a neutral spine, light grip on the handlebars, and drive smoothly through the full pedal stroke, keeping your cadence steady and your knees tracking in line with your feet.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: Dead Bug is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, ribs down, then extend opposite arm and leg while keeping your spine glued to the floor.

exercises.name: Dead Hang (Mobility Focus)
exercises.description: Dead Hang (Mobility Focus) is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, upperback while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar and let your body hang heavy, relax your shoulders down away from your ears, and take slow breaths as your spine and lats gently lengthen.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: A fundamental floor pull where you hinge at the hips and stand tall, training full-body strength from your grip to your glutes.
exercises.instructions: Set your feet about hip-width, grip the bar just outside your legs, and pull your chest up until your back is flat; push the floor away, driving your hips forward as the bar stays close to your shins and thighs, then stand tall without leaning back.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
exercises.description: A barbell press on a decline bench that targets the lower chest while still challenging your triceps and shoulders.
exercises.instructions: Lower the bar toward lower chest, stay tight through your core, and drive upward without flaring your elbows.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly
exercises.description: A chest fly on a decline bench that targets the lower chest, creating deep stretch and powerful contraction at the bottom of the movement.
exercises.instructions: On a decline bench, sweep your arms outward, stretching your chest, then pull them back together in a controlled arc.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.description: Decline Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: On a decline bench, keep your lower back pressed down, curl your torso upward, and control your descent without using momentum.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift performed from a small platform, increasing your range of motion and building strength from the very bottom of the pull.
exercises.instructions: Stand on a small platform or plate, grab the bar with your normal deadlift setup, and brace hard; push through the floor to break the bar off the ground, staying patient off the bottom, then stand tall while keeping your back tight and neutral.

exercises.name: Devil Press
exercises.description: A ground-to-overhead dumbbell movement that starts with a burpee-style pickup and finishes in a strong press, testing power and resilience.
exercises.instructions: Hinge to grab the dumbbells, kick back into a burpee, snap your feet in, then swing and drive the dumbbells overhead in one powerful arc, finishing tall with locked-out arms.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description: Diamond Push-Up is a pressing pattern that builds driving strength through your shoulders, chest, and arms, targeting push, triceps, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers under your chest, hold a strong plank, then lower your torso and press back up, emphasizing a hard squeeze through your triceps.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.description: A forward-leaning calf raise that places a deep stretch on the calves, helping you build explosive lower-leg power.
exercises.instructions: Hinge slightly forward, push through your toes, and lift your heels high while keeping hips stable.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.description: Doorway Pec Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, chest while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Set your forearm on the side of a doorway, elbow at shoulder height, then step your body forward and slightly turn away to open the front of your chest and shoulder.

exercises.name: Drag Curl
exercises.description: A biceps curl where you drag the bar up your torso, keeping elbows back to maximize tension through every inch of the lift.
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar up your body by driving your elbows back, keeping the bar close and emphasizing biceps tension at every point.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description: Dragon Flag is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hold the bench behind your head, lift your body into one rigid line, and lower slowly from your shoulders without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: A single-arm row that lets you brace with the other hand, focusing on strong pulls and deep squeezes through your lats and upper back.
exercises.instructions: Set one hand and knee on a bench, keep your spine long, and let the dumbbell hang under your shoulder; row the weight toward your hip, leading with your elbow and keeping it close to your body, then lower slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Dumble Squeeze Press
exercises.description: A dumbbell press where you crush the bells together, maximizing inner-chest activation and triceps drive through every rep.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench, squeeze the dumbbells together over your chest, and press while keeping constant inward tension.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.description: A low-impact gliding stride that trains the legs and cardiovascular system while keeping joints happy and movement fluid.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall without leaning on the handles, push and pull through your legs in a smooth oval path, and keep your core engaged as your arms follow the handles.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
exercises.description: A classic curl using the EZ bar to hit your biceps hard while reducing wrist strain and building strong, rounded upper arms.
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar comfortably, keep elbows fixed, and curl the bar up by driving through your biceps while maintaining a steady torso.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: A rope-based pull that strengthens rear delts, upper back, and shoulder health.
exercises.instructions: Set the rope at about eye level, step back into a strong stance, and start with your arms straight; pull the rope toward your face by leading with your elbows out to the sides and separating your hands, squeezing the backs of your shoulders before returning under control.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry
exercises.description: A heavy loaded walk with weights at your sides, strengthening your grip, core, and posture as you stay tall with every step.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with heavy weights at your sides, shoulders pulled down and back, and ribs stacked over your hips; walk with small, controlled steps, keeping your grip crushed on the handles and your posture tall from start to finish.

exercises.name: Figure Four Stretch
exercises.description: Figure Four Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hips, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the uncrossed leg toward your chest until you feel a deep but comfortable stretch in your glute and outer hip.

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.description: A chest press performed lying on the floor, limiting range at the bottom to protect your shoulders while building triceps and upper-chest strength.
exercises.instructions: Lie on the floor, plant elbows at 45°, and press the weights up powerfully while keeping your lats tight for stability.

exercises.name: Floor Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Floor Tricep Dips is a vertical press that builds dense strength in your chest, shoulders, and triceps, targeting push, triceps, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and fingers pointing forward, lift your hips slightly, and bend only at the elbows to lower your body before pressing back up through straight arms.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description: Flutter Kicks is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor, and make small, fast kicks with straight legs while keeping your core locked.

exercises.name: Freestanding Handstand Hold
exercises.description: Freestanding Handstand Hold is an inverted hold that strengthens your shoulders, wrists, and core while sharpening balance, targeting push, full body, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Kick up softly, find your balance by pressing the floor away and adjusting with your fingertips, and keep your body tight from toes to fingertips as you hover in place.

exercises.name: Frog Jump
exercises.description: Frog Jump is a plyometric movement that trains fast, forceful extension through your hips, knees, and ankles, targeting squat, quads, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Sink into a wide squat, swing your arms forward, and drive off the ground to leap forward, landing with your hips back to absorb the impact.

exercises.name: Front Lever Hold
exercises.description: Front Lever Hold is a vertical pulling pattern that carves out your back and arms while demanding core control, targeting pull, full body, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: From a hang, pull your shoulders down and back, lift your hips until your body is parallel to the ground, and squeeze everything to stay straight like a board.

exercises.name: Front Rack Carry
exercises.description: A carry with the load held in front of your chest, challenging your breathing, posture, and core as you move under tension.
exercises.instructions: Set the weights in a solid front rack with elbows lifted and wrists neutral, brace your midsection, and keep your chest proud; walk forward with steady steps, keeping the load close to your body and your core locked in like a moving plank.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.description: A forward arm lift targeting the front delts, creating strong, defined shoulder lines.
exercises.instructions: Stand upright with the weights resting in front of your thighs, brace your core, and lift one or both arms straight forward until the hands hit shoulder height; keep your shoulders down away from your ears and lower the weights with the same control you used to raise them.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: A front-loaded squat that challenges your quads and core as you stay tall, developing strength and clean, upright posture.
exercises.instructions: Rack the bar on your front delts with elbows high, brace your core like you're about to be punched, and sit straight down between your hips; keep your chest lifted, drive your elbows forward, and push the floor away to stand up powerfully.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A floor bridge where you press through your heels and lift your hips, firing up your glutes and supporting a healthy lower back.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with feet flat and heels close to your glutes, brace your core, and push through your heels to lift your hips; finish in a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeeze your glutes, then lower your hips without letting your low back take over.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.description: A bodyweight curl on the GHR where you lower under control and drive back up, hammering your hamstrings and glutes without loading your spine.
exercises.instructions: Lock your feet into the glute-ham developer, start with your body in a straight line, and cross your arms or keep them at your chest; control your descent by resisting with your hamstrings, then squeeze them hard to curl your body back to the starting line.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.description: A controlled backward leg drive that isolates the glutes, teaching you to extend from the hip for a stronger stride and posture.
exercises.instructions: Start on all fours, brace your core so your back stays flat, and drive one heel straight back and slightly up as if stamping the ceiling; squeeze your glute at the top without twisting your hips, then return your knee under your hip with control.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.description: A glute-ham variation emphasizing a strong hip hinge and knee bend together, training the entire posterior chain for explosive power.
exercises.instructions: Secure your feet in the glute-ham developer with your knees on the pad, start tall with your body straight, and cross your arms or keep them at your chest; lean forward under control until you feel your hamstrings stretch, then drive your toes into the platform and squeeze your hamstrings to return.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: A single-dumbbell squat held at your chest, teaching control, bracing, and full-leg strength in a simple, effective way.
exercises.instructions: Hold the weight close to your chest like a heavy goblet, point your elbows slightly down, and sit between your heels; keep your chest open, knees pushing out, and stand up by driving the floor away without letting the weight pull you forward.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: A bar-on-back hip hinge where you bow forward with control, building powerful hamstrings, glutes, and a resilient lower back.
exercises.instructions: Place the bar across your upper back, unlock your knees, and hinge by pushing your hips straight back; keep your spine long and chest pointed slightly forward, then drive your hips forward to stand tall once you feel a strong hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Good-Grip Dead Hang
exercises.description: Good-Grip Dead Hang is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting pull, back, back, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar securely, let your body hang long, and maintain active shoulders while building grip strength.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row
exercises.description: A dual‑dumbbell row where you hinge low and pull explosively for full‑back power.
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet wide and kettlebells between them, hinge forward with a flat back, and keep one bell anchored to the floor; row the other bell up toward your hip, keeping your shoulders level, then alternate sides in a smooth, powerful rhythm.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: A machine-guided squat that lets you push heavy through a stable path, focusing on quad drive and powerful leg strength.
exercises.instructions: Place your shoulders under the pads and feet slightly forward on the platform, brace, and sink down as if sliding in an elevator; keep your lower back pressed into the pad, then drive through your heels to return to the top without locking your knees hard.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: A neutral-grip curl that targets your biceps and brachialis, building dense upper arms while keeping your wrists strong and comfortable.
exercises.instructions: Hold the weights neutral, keep elbows close, and curl straight up using your biceps and brachialis without swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: Hamstring Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hamstrings, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, hinge forward from your hips with a long spine, and reach toward your toes while keeping a slight bend in your knees to load the back of your legs without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold (Wall)
exercises.description: Handstand Hold (Wall) is an inverted hold that strengthens your shoulders, wrists, and core while sharpening balance, targeting push, full body, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Kick up with your heels resting lightly on the wall, push the floor away through straight arms, and stack wrists, shoulders, hips, and heels in one strong line.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.description: Handstand Push-Up is a pressing pattern that builds driving strength through your shoulders, chest, and arms, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Kick into a handstand, lower the top of your head toward the floor with elbows tight, then drive straight up by pressing the floor away and staying stacked through your midline.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.description: A hang-based clean that focuses on explosive hip extension and quick elbows, reinforcing speed and crisp receiving positions.
exercises.instructions: From the hang at mid-thigh, dip slightly, explode upward as if jumping, and drop under to receive the bar on your shoulders with your elbows lifted and core tight.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
exercises.description: A snatch variation starting from the hang that sharpens timing, bar path, and hip drive while reducing load on the lower back.
exercises.instructions: Start with the bar at your thighs, hinge slightly to load your hips, then jump the bar upward and pull under to catch it overhead with locked elbows and a braced core.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.description: Hanging Knee Raise is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hang with active shoulders, then pull your knees toward your chest without letting your body sway.

exercises.name: Hanging L-Sit
exercises.description: A hanging hold with legs lifted into an L shape, challenging your grip, lats, and core to stay strong and still without swinging.
exercises.instructions: From a strong hang, engage your lats, then raise your legs to hip height, locking your knees to form an L shape and holding steady without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hanging Leg Raise is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar, engage your lats, then lift your legs straight to hip height or higher without swinging.

exercises.name: Heel Taps
exercises.description: Heel Taps is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, lift your shoulders, and reach side-to-side tapping your heels while keeping your abs tight and hips steady.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Running in place with knees lifted high to hip level, challenging your heart rate, coordination, and quick, springy footwork.
exercises.instructions: Run in place, lifting your knees to hip height with each step, pump your arms aggressively, and land softly on the balls of your feet to keep a fast, springy rhythm.

exercises.name: High Pull
exercises.description: An explosive pull from the floor or hang that drives the weight up toward your chest, building upper-back power and athletic extension.
exercises.instructions: From a strong hinge, extend your hips and knees aggressively, then pull the weight up toward your chest with elbows high and wide, keeping it close to your body.

exercises.name: High Row
exercises.description: A row pattern where you pull high toward your upper chest, targeting the rear delts and upper back for better posture and shoulder health.
exercises.instructions: Set the handles just above shoulder height, grip firmly, and lean your chest slightly into the pad; pull the handles down and back in a high arc toward your upper ribs, squeezing your upper back, then let your arms fully extend for a strong stretch.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.description: Hip Abduction is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abductors, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand or lie as needed, lift your leg outward using your glutes while keeping your hips level and toes forward.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction
exercises.description: Hip Adduction is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, adductors, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Move your leg inward across your midline with control, focusing on squeezing your inner thigh.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
exercises.description: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch is a unilateral leg exercise that builds strength, stability, and coordination one side at a time, targeting squat, quads, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Step into a long lunge with your back knee down, tuck your tailbone under, and gently shift your hips forward while keeping your chest tall to open the front of the back hip.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: A hip-dominant lift where you drive your hips up and squeeze hard at the top, building strong, explosive glutes and hamstrings.
exercises.instructions: Position your upper back on a bench, roll the bar into your hip crease, and plant your feet so your shins are vertical at the top; drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeezing your glutes hard before lowering under control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rock
exercises.description: A tight hollow hold that gently rocks forward and back, teaching you to maintain rigid core tension and control through movement.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, lift shoulders and legs to create a tight banana shape, squeeze your core, and gently rock forward and back without letting your lower back leave the floor.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.description: Hollow Hold is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Form a banana shape by lifting your shoulders and legs, squeezing your core so your lower back stays pressed into the floor.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.description: A barbell press on an incline bench that emphasizes your upper chest and front shoulders for a lifted, athletic chest.
exercises.instructions: Set a slight incline, lower the bar toward upper chest, and press upward while keeping your shoulders stable.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly
exercises.description: A chest fly on an incline bench that emphasizes the upper chest, shaping the top portion of your pecs with controlled, wide arcs.
exercises.instructions: On an incline bench, open your arms wide, feel the upper-chest stretch, and bring the weights together smoothly.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: A curl performed on an incline bench that stretches the biceps deeply, helping you build long, full-looking muscle.
exercises.instructions: Lie back on an incline bench, let your arms hang behind you, and curl the weights while preventing your shoulders from rolling forward.

exercises.name: Incline Push-up
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands elevated, making the movement more accessible while still strengthening your chest, shoulders, and core.
exercises.instructions: Place your hands elevated, keep a straight line from head to heels, and press through your chest with controlled reps.

exercises.name: Incline Walk Treadmill
exercises.description: A steady uphill walk on the treadmill that strengthens your glutes and calves while boosting heart rate without pounding your joints.
exercises.instructions: Set a challenging incline, step with your whole foot on each stride, drive through your glutes, and avoid leaning your weight onto the rails as you climb.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: A horizontal bodyweight row that strengthens mid‑back and grip with scalable difficulty.
exercises.instructions: Position yourself under the bar, grab it with an overhand grip, and straighten your body from head to heels; pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows back, pinch your shoulder blades together at the top, then lower until your arms are fully extended again.

exercises.name: Inverted Row Feet Elevated
exercises.description: An elevated-feet row intensifying back engagement through a steeper pulling angle.
exercises.instructions: Place your heels on a bench or box, grab the bar, and form a straight line from shoulders to feet; row your chest up to the bar, keeping your hips lifted and core tight, then lower slowly to increase time under tension.

exercises.name: Iso-lateral Row
exercises.description: A machine‑style iso row that trains each side independently for balanced strength.
exercises.instructions: Sit in the machine with your chest against the pad, grab both handles, and pull your shoulders down and back; row one or both arms by driving your elbows past your torso, squeezing each side of your back individually, then release the handles slowly for a full stretch.

exercises.name: Jack Knife
exercises.description: Jack Knife is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie long, then lift your legs and torso together, reaching your hands toward your shins as your core drives the movement.

exercises.name: Jefferson Deadlift
exercises.description: An off-set deadlift with the bar between your legs, challenging your hips, core, and grip with a unique stance-driven pull.
exercises.instructions: Straddle the bar with one foot in front and one behind, grab the bar with a mixed grip between your legs, and brace your core; drive through both feet to stand straight up, keeping the bar close and your torso centered between your hips.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.description: Rhythmic hops over the rope that challenge timing, coordination, and cardio, teaching you to stay light and quick on your feet.
exercises.instructions: Hold the handles at hip height, spin the rope with quick wrist flicks, and hop lightly on the balls of your feet with small, controlled jumps just high enough for the rope to clear.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.description: Jump Squat is a plyometric movement that trains fast, forceful extension through your hips, knees, and ankles, targeting squat, quads, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Drop into a controlled squat, then explode upward, extending your hips and knees, and land softly back into your squat with an active, braced core.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
exercises.description: Jumping Lunge is a plyometric movement that trains fast, forceful extension through your hips, knees, and ankles, targeting squat, quads, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Step into a lunge, jump and switch legs mid-air, and land in a balanced lunge with your front knee stacked over your ankle.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.description: A circular kettlebell rotation around your head that builds shoulder mobility and control.
exercises.instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at chest level, tighten your core, and slowly circle it around your head like a crown; keep the bell close, elbows tucked in, and move smoothly in both directions without letting your ribs flare.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: A hip-driven swing of the kettlebell that loads your glutes and hamstrings, building explosive power and strong, resilient hips.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips, hike the bell back, then snap your hips forward to float the kettlebell to chest height, letting your arms stay relaxed as the bell swings.

exercises.name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
exercises.description: Kipping Handstand Push-Up is a pressing pattern that builds driving strength through your shoulders, chest, and arms, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: From a handstand, lower to the bottom, then tuck your knees and snap your legs up as you press, using the kip to help you drive to full lockout.

exercises.name: Kipping Pull-Up
exercises.description: Kipping Pull-Up is a vertical pulling pattern that carves out your back and arms while demanding core control, targeting pull, lats, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Flow between hollow and arch shapes, then snap your hips and pull with your lats to bring your chin over the bar, returning smoothly into your swing for the next rep.

exercises.name: Kipping Toes-to-Bar
exercises.description: A dynamic, swinging version of toes-to-bar that uses a strong kip to cycle reps efficiently while keeping rhythm and control.
exercises.instructions: Flow between hollow and arch swings, then aggressively close your hips and snap your legs up to tag the bar, quickly returning to your kip rhythm for the next rep.

exercises.name: Kneeling Pulldown
exercises.description: A lat pulldown done from a kneeling stance, forcing extra core bracing as you drive your elbows down to build a strong, athletic back.
exercises.instructions: Kneel in front of the cable, grab the bar or handles overhead, and sit your hips back slightly; pull your elbows down toward your ribs as you bring the bar to your upper chest or collarbone, squeeze your lats, then let your arms rise with control.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push-up
exercises.description: A beginner-friendly push-up variation performed from the knees, letting you groove perfect form while you build pressing strength.
exercises.instructions: From knees, keep a straight body line, lower your chest fully, and press up while maintaining tension.

exercises.name: L-Sit( Parallettes)
exercises.description: A support hold on parallettes with legs extended straight out, demanding serious core strength, shoulder stability, and body control.
exercises.instructions: Press the bars down, lock your elbows, lift your hips, then extend your legs straight out in front with pointed toes, keeping your body still and core fully engaged.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description: A diagonal pressing pattern using a landmine bar to build powerful shoulders and upper chest with a joint-friendly arc.
exercises.instructions: Stand staggered, press the bar up and forward, and keep your ribs down while driving through your shoulder and core.

exercises.name: Landmine Press Single Arm
exercises.description: A rear-delt-focused fly that opens your arms outward, strengthening the back of your shoulders for better posture.
exercises.instructions: Stand facing the landmine with one hand on the bar end at shoulder height, brace your core, and stagger your stance; press the bar up and forward in an arc, fully extending your arm, then lower it back under control.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.description: A landmine row providing an arcing pull that targets mid‑back and lats.
exercises.instructions: Stand over the landmine bar with a strong hip hinge and a flat back, grasp the handle or bar end; pull the weight toward your lower ribs or waistline, keeping your elbows tucked, then lower in a controlled arc without rounding your spine.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.description: A single-leg leg press that builds unilateral strength, correcting imbalances and improving hip stability.
exercises.instructions: Hold the end of the bar close to your chest, step slightly forward, and sit your hips down and back; let the bar travel in a natural arc, keep your core braced, and push the floor away to stand tall while keeping the bar tight to your body.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat& Press
exercises.description: A landmine squat that flows into an overhead press, building leg drive, shoulder strength, and core stability in a smooth arc.
exercises.instructions: Hold the landmine at your chest, drop into a strong squat with your elbows tucked, and keep your heels grounded; as you stand, use your leg drive to smoothly punch the bar up and forward, finishing with your arm extended and your core braced.

exercises.name: Landmine180
exercises.description: Landmine180 is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding a landmine bar, rotate your torso as you guide the bar in a wide arc, keeping your hips stable and power coming from your obliques.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A cable pull from overhead where you drive the bar to your chest, building wide lats and a strong, stable upper back.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with your thighs locked under the pad, grab the bar just outside shoulder-width, and pull your shoulders down; draw the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, pause to squeeze your lats, then let the bar rise with control.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.description: A side-stepping band drill that lights up your outer hips, improving knee stability, hip strength, and athletic lateral movement.
exercises.instructions: Step into the band just above your knees or at your ankles, sink into a quarter squat, and push your knees slightly out; take small, controlled steps sideways, keeping tension on the band and your hips level as you move.

exercises.name: Lateral Box Jump
exercises.description: Lateral Box Jump is a side‑to‑side plyometric drill that builds agility, balance, and sharp single‑leg power, targeting squat, quads, legs, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Face sideways, load your outside leg, and hop onto the box with a crisp lateral push, landing centered and stable before stepping down and repeating.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.description: A rear-foot support squat that lets you load heavily with good posture, targeting quads and glutes with stability.
exercises.instructions: Step out wide to the side, sit your hips back over the stepping leg, and keep the opposite leg straight; keep your chest lifted, knee tracking over your toes, then drive off the bent leg to return to center.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.description: A lateral arm lift that isolates the side delts, building shoulder width and control through a smooth, deliberate arc.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with weights by your sides, lead with your elbows, and lift your arms outward until they reach shoulder height; keep a slight bend in your elbows and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Full ROM
exercises.description: A full-range lateral raise that lifts from hip to overhead, building shoulder control and width.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows, start the dumbbells slightly in front of your body, and sweep them out and up until they're just above shoulder level; think about pushing the weights out to the walls, then slowly guide them all the way back to your sides without swinging.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Seated
exercises.description: A seated lateral raise that isolates your side delts with strict form and steady tension.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall at the edge of the bench with your feet planted, lock your ribs down, and raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your hands reach about shoulder height; lead with your elbows, pause briefly at the top, then lower under control without letting the weights rest on your thighs.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Single Arm
exercises.description: A one-arm lateral raise that sharpens shoulder symmetry and control by making each side work on its own with precise tension.
exercises.instructions: Hold onto a support with one hand and the weight in the other; raise the working arm out to the side until shoulder level, pause, then lower under control while keeping your shoulder away from your ear.

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffles
exercises.description: A low, side-to-side shuffle that builds lateral quickness, leg strength, and control while teaching you to stay ready and reactive.
exercises.instructions: Sink into a half-squat, stay low, and push off your outside foot to shuffle sideways, making sure your feet don't cross and your chest stays up.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: A broad squat stance with toes out, hitting your inner thighs and glutes while promoting a deep, powerful squat pattern.
exercises.instructions: Sit with your back against the pad, align your knees with the machine's pivot, and grip the handles; straighten your legs by squeezing your quads, lock out with a brief pause, then lower the weight smoothly without letting it crash.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: A horizontal press variation that trains leg power with a different angle to build well-rounded lower-body strength.
exercises.instructions: Place your feet shoulder-width on the platform, unlock the safeties, and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees; keep your lower back glued to the pad, then drive the platform away through your heels.

exercises.name: Leg Press Horizontal
exercises.description: A shoulder mobility and stability drill sweeping weights overhead in a big circle to challenge posture and control.
exercises.instructions: Lie flat against the pad, place your feet on the moving plate, and lower it toward you until your thighs approach your torso; maintain contact with the pad, then push the plate away by driving through your whole foot.

exercises.name: Leg Press Single-Leg
exercises.description: A backward kneeling lean that trains quads and hip flexors while improving knee and thigh tendon strength.
exercises.instructions: Center one foot on the platform, hug the handles, and lower the sled slowly using that leg only; keep your hips square, knee tracking over your toes, and press the platform away in a smooth, controlled drive.

exercises.name: Low Cable Fly
exercises.description: A low‑cable fly emphasizing chest stretch, squeeze, and controlled adduction.
exercises.instructions: Stand in a staggered stance between the low pulleys, grab the handles with palms facing up or in, and step forward; with a slight bend in the elbows, sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest like hugging a barrel, squeeze your chest, then open back up until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.description: A step-down pattern that builds eccentric quad strength and balance, improving knee health and stair control.
exercises.instructions: Take a comfortable step forward, drop your back knee toward the floor, and keep your front heel grounded; maintain an upright torso, then push through the front leg to return to standing without letting your knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Lying Knee Raise
exercises.description: Lying Knee Raise is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie flat, brace your core, then draw your knees toward your chest without swinging, lowering them slowly to reset.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: A face-down leg curl that locks your body in place, letting you attack the hamstrings with strong, controlled contractions.
exercises.instructions: Lie face down on the bench, set the pad just above your heels, and press your hips into the pad; curl your heels toward your glutes, pause at the top to feel your hamstrings contract, then lower in a smooth, controlled motion.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.description: Lying Leg Raise is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Press your lower back down, lift your legs together to vertical, and lower them under control without letting your hips tilt.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Curls
exercises.description: A lying neck curl that builds front-neck strength, improving posture and resilience in grappling, contact sports, and daily movement.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench with your head hanging off, tuck your chin slightly, and slowly nod your head forward as if making a double chin; curl your neck up against the resistance, pause, then lower smoothly without letting your head drop.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Extensions
exercises.description: A face-down neck extension that strengthens the back of your neck, enhancing posture and protecting against strain.
exercises.instructions: Face down with your head off the bench, keep your gaze toward the floor and your neck long; lift the back of your head toward the ceiling using your neck muscles, hold briefly, then return to the start in a controlled arc.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.description: A guided pressing motion on a chest machine, letting you push heavy with control and safely overload your pecs and triceps.
exercises.instructions: Set the seat height, keep shoulders down, and press the handles forward with smooth, chest-driven force.

exercises.name: Man Maker
exercises.description: A dumbbell complex that blends a plank, row, push-up, and press to train total-body strength, control, and conditioning in one sequence.
exercises.instructions: With dumbbells on the floor, perform a push-up, row each dumbbell from a solid plank, jump your feet in, then clean and press the weights overhead in one continuous, controlled sequence.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.description: A unilateral landmine row emphasizing lat stretch, oblique tension, and back power.
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to the landmine, hinge at your hips with the inside hand braced on your thigh or bench, and grab the end of the bar with the outside hand; let your shoulder stretch at the bottom, then row the bar up toward your hip, focusing on squeezing your lat on that side.

exercises.name: Med Ball Slam
exercises.description: Med Ball Slam is an explosive power move where you drive through your legs and core to move the load with speed, targeting push, full body while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand in an athletic stance, raise the ball overhead with extended arms, then crunch your ribs down and drive through your legs as you slam the ball into the floor with full power.

exercises.name: Med Ball Throws
exercises.description: Med Ball Throws is an explosive power move where you drive through your legs and core to launch the ball with speed, targeting push, full_body, full_body, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand athletic, load your hips, then whip the ball overhead or from the chest, driving through your legs and core to launch it with full intent while keeping your spine stable.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.description: A strict vertical press that builds powerful shoulders and a stable upper body.
exercises.instructions: Stand with your feet together or hip-width, bar at shoulder height, and glutes tight; press the weight straight overhead while keeping your torso tall and your ribs pulled down, then lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: Fast, alternating knee drives from a strong plank that fire up your core, shoulders, and legs while training speed and stamina.
exercises.instructions: Set a strong plank with shoulders over wrists, then drive your knees toward your chest in a quick running motion while keeping your hips low and core braced.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-up
exercises.description: A slow, controlled lower from the top of the bar, using just the descent to build the strength needed for full pull-ups.
exercises.instructions: Use a box or jump to start at the top with your chest near the bar, then lock in your shoulders and core; slowly lower yourself down for a controlled count, resisting gravity all the way until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.description: A partner or anchored leg curl where you fight gravity on the way down, building brutally strong hamstrings and bulletproofing against injury.
exercises.instructions: Anchor your ankles, kneel tall with your hips extended, and brace your core; slowly lower your body toward the floor by resisting with your hamstrings, catch yourself with your hands if needed, then push lightly off the floor to help pull yourself back up.

exercises.name: Obliquecrunch
exercises.description: Obliquecrunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, rotate your knees to one side, then curl your torso toward your hip to target your obliques with each rep.

exercises.name: One Arm Push-up
exercises.description: A challenging single-arm push-up that demands extreme core tension, shoulder stability, and raw upper-body power.
exercises.instructions: Widen your feet, brace your core, and lower slowly on one arm before pressing up with full-body control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Row
exercises.description: One-Arm Row is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting pull, back, back, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Brace with one hand, pull the weight toward your hip with a tight back, and lower slowly for full control.

exercises.name: Open Books
exercises.description: Open Books is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting rotation, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stacked, then rotate your top arm and chest open toward the floor behind you, letting your gaze follow your hand for a smooth thoracic twist.

exercises.name: Overhead Carry
exercises.description: A loaded overhead walk that challenges shoulder stability, core control, and posture.
exercises.instructions: Press the weights straight overhead and lock out your elbows, stack your wrists over your shoulders and your shoulders over your hips; walk forward with small, steady steps, keeping your core braced and the weights directly above you rather than drifting forward.

exercises.name: Overhead Curl
exercises.description: A unique curl performed with arms overhead, challenging your biceps and shoulders while demanding serious core stability.
exercises.instructions: Hold the weight overhead with elbows slightly forward, then curl by bending only at the elbows while keeping your arms stable.

exercises.name: Overhead Lunge
exercises.description: A machine leg press that loads your quads and glutes through a guided path, letting you push heavy with control.
exercises.instructions: Press the weight overhead with locked-out elbows, then step into a lunge while keeping your arms in line with your ears; brace your core and drive through the front heel while keeping the weight stacked over your hips.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: A rotational shoulder press inspired by Arnold Schwarzenegger, building full-range delt strength with fluid motion.
exercises.instructions: Stand with the bar at your shoulders, grip just outside shoulder-width, and squeeze your glutes and core; press the bar overhead in a straight path, moving your head slightly back then through as you lock out.

exercises.name: Overhead Press Seated
exercises.description: A banded pull-apart that strengthens the upper back and rear delts, improving posture and shoulder health.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with feet planted and back lightly against the pad; press the bar or dumbbells straight up until your arms are extended, then lower until your elbows come just below shoulder level.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.description: A full-body squat with the bar locked overhead, building mobile hips, strong shoulders, and rock-solid core control under load.
