exercises.instructions: Set the bar overhead with locked-out elbows, ribs down, and feet about shoulder-width; sit your hips straight down between your heels while keeping the bar stacked over the middle of your foot, then drive through the floor to stand tall without letting the bar drift forward.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.description: A chest press machine motion providing guided tension for focused chest engagement.
exercises.instructions: Stand or sit with the weight held overhead, elbows pointing forward and close to your head; bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head in a smooth arc, then extend your arms again, focusing on driving through your triceps rather than your shoulders.

exercises.name: Pall of Press
exercises.description: Pall of Press is a pressing movement that builds driving force through your chest, shoulders, and arms, targeting rotation, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stand perpendicular to resistance, press the handle forward, and fight rotation by bracing your core hard.

exercises.name: Paused Back Squat
exercises.description: A heel-elevated squat that helps you achieve deeper range, targeting quads and improving upright torso posture.
exercises.instructions: Squat down to your depth, then hold at the bottom for a full, solid pause while staying tight; no bouncing-after the pause, drive your feet into the floor and push your hips and chest up together.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts
exercises.description: Pelvic Tilts is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, other, core while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, gently tuck your tailbone to press your lower back into the floor, then slowly release, moving segment by segment to wake up your deep core.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.description: A fast, explosive row from the floor with barbell strictness for upper‑back strength.
exercises.instructions: Set the bar on the floor, hinge until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, and grab the bar with a shoulder-width grip; from a dead stop each rep, brace hard and pull the bar explosively toward your lower chest, then let it return fully to the floor before repeating.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.description: Pigeon Pose is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hips, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Bring one shin forward across your mat, slide the back leg straight, then square your hips and fold over your front leg, breathing slowly to relax into the outer hip.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.description: A hips-high push-up variation that targets shoulders through a vertical pressing angle.
exercises.instructions: Set your hips high so your body forms an upside-down V, hands just wider than shoulder-width; lower the top of your head toward the floor by bending your elbows, then drive the floor away to press back up, keeping your weight stacked over your shoulders.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.description: Pistol Squat is a lower-body strength move that challenges your quads, glutes, and balance, targeting squat, quads, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Extend one leg forward, sit your hips back and down over the standing foot, then push through your heel to stand, keeping your chest lifted and knee tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat to Box
exercises.description: A narrow-stance press that drives intense quad activation through a focused foot position.
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg in front of the box, extend the other leg forward, and slowly sit back onto the box under control; keep your chest high, then drive through the standing heel to stand without rocking or bouncing.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Plank is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Set a straight line from head to heels, press the floor away, squeeze your glutes, and keep your ribs tucked.

exercises.name: Plank Push-up
exercises.description: A hybrid of plank and push-up where you hold a rigid body line as you press, blending core stability with upper-body strength.
exercises.instructions: Shift from plank forearms to hands by pressing through one arm at a time while keeping hips stable.

exercises.name: Plate Curl
exercises.description: A fingertip-loaded curl where you grip a plate and raise it up, building crushing grip strength and thick, responsive biceps.
exercises.instructions: Grip the plate with fingers tight, curl it upward while keeping elbows close, and squeeze the top before lowering with control.

exercises.name: Plate Press
exercises.description: A close-grip press squeezing a plate between your hands, lighting up your chest and triceps while teaching powerful midline pressure.
exercises.instructions: Press the plate straight out in front, squeeze your chest hard, and maintain tension as you extend and pull back.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.description: A high-catch clean that emphasizes powerful triple extension and athletic receiving mechanics without sitting into a full squat.
exercises.instructions: Push hard through your legs, keep the bar skimming your body, and snap your elbows through to catch it high on your shoulders, finishing in a tall, athletic stance.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.description: A dynamic Olympic lift that drives the weight from ground to overhead in one motion, training speed, precision, and full-body explosiveness.
exercises.instructions: From mid-shin, push through the floor, extend your hips explosively, and pull the bar overhead in one motion, locking out your arms as you catch it with active shoulders.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.description: A strict curl with your arm supported on a bench, isolating the biceps so you build peak strength without using momentum.
exercises.instructions: Rest your arm on the pad, lower the weight fully, and curl upward with slow, deliberate control, keeping tension in your biceps the entire time.

exercises.name: Psoas Releaseon Ball
exercises.description: Psoas Releaseon Ball is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, other, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with a soft ball under the front of your hip, relax your weight into it, and take slow breaths as you gently shift side to side to release deep hip tension.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.description: A classic overhand bodyweight pull where you lift your chin over the bar, building serious back, arm, and grip strength.
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with your shoulders active and legs still, brace your core, and drive your elbows down; pull your chest toward the bar, pause when your chin clears it, then lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pullover
exercises.description: A long-arc upper-body move where you sweep the weight overhead and back, stretching and strengthening your lats and chest together.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench with the weight held above your chest and a slight bend in your elbows, brace your core, and lower the weight in an arc behind your head; feel the stretch through your lats, then use them to sweep the weight back up over your chest without bending at the elbows.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.description: A seated overhead press with legs out in front, demanding strict core and shoulder strength without momentum.
exercises.instructions: Clean the bar to your shoulders, brace your core, and dip by bending your knees slightly; explode upward through your legs and punch the bar overhead, locking out strong before lowering with control.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: A classic bodyweight press where you brace your core and drive the floor away to build full upper-body strength anywhere.
exercises.instructions: Form a rigid plank, lower your chest to the floor, and press back up while keeping elbows angled at about 45°.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.description: A push‑up holding a long top position to maximize chest and shoulder time‑under‑tension.
exercises.instructions: Set the bar on the rack just below your knees or mid-shin, stand with feet hip-width, and grip the bar just outside your legs; brace your core, pull the slack out of the bar, then drive your feet into the ground to stand tall, locking your hips through without leaning back.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: A classic overhead press driving the weight straight up, building shoulder strength, upper-back stability, and core control.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips with a flat back and let the weights hang; sweep your arms out and back like you're opening wings, squeezing your rear delts at the top before lowering slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly
exercises.description: A seated overhead press variation that limits leg drive, forcing pure shoulder and upper-back strength.
exercises.instructions: Set yourself on a reverse fly machine or chest-supported bench, plant your chest firmly, and start with arms slightly bent; pull the handles or weights out and back, driving from the backs of your shoulders before returning smoothly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Row
exercises.description: Rear Delt Row is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting pull, back, arms, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips, pull the weight toward your chest with elbows flared, and squeeze your rear delts at the top.

exercises.name: Rear Kick
exercises.description: A backward kicking pattern that engages glutes and hamstrings, building hip power and control with each strong extension.
exercises.instructions: Stand or brace against the machine pad, plant your supporting leg, and press the working heel straight back through the pad; keep your torso steady, squeeze your glute at full extension, then bring your leg back under your hip without letting the weight slam.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
exercises.description: A renegade row blending plank stability with powerful unilateral back pulling.
exercises.instructions: Set up in a plank position with hands on the dumbbells, feet wide for stability, and your body in a straight line; row one dumbbell toward your hip while resisting any hip rotation, lower it back down quietly, then alternate sides while keeping your plank tight.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.description: Reverse Crunch is a high‑output effort that builds speed, stamina, and crisp running mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, pull your knees toward your chest and lift your hips off the floor, lowering slowly with control.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.description: A palms-down curl that shifts the emphasis to your forearms and brachialis, creating thicker, stronger arms and healthier elbows.
exercises.instructions: Grip the bar overhand, keep elbows tight, and curl the weight while emphasizing your forearms and the top of your biceps.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly
exercises.description: A reverse fly that opens your upper back and rear delts for balanced shoulder strength.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips with a flat back and let the weights hang beneath your chest; sweep your arms out wide in a 'T' shape, thinking about driving your elbows toward the walls and pinching your shoulder blades together, then lower the weights slowly without losing your hinge position.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly Single Arm
exercises.description: A single-arm reverse fly allowing precise rear‑delt isolation and improved symmetry.
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward with one hand braced on a bench and a dumbbell in the other; raise the working arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it's in line with your shoulder, squeeze your upper back, then lower with control before repeating on the other side.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: A curved-glide lunge that targets inner thighs and glutes, improving lateral stability and hip control.
exercises.instructions: Step backward instead of forward, drop the back knee toward the ground, and keep your front shin mostly vertical; drive through the front heel to return to standing, staying tall and stable through your core.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic Curl
exercises.description: A dip-and-drive overhead press that blends leg power with upper-body strength for explosive shoulder development.
exercises.instructions: Kneel upright with your hips extended, squeeze your glutes, and slowly lean your body backward from the knees while keeping a straight line; go as far as you can control, then use your quads to pull yourself back up.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.description: A small but intense forearm move where you lift the back of the hand up, strengthening the extensors that balance your grip.
exercises.instructions: Rest your forearms on a bench, palms down, and lift the back of your hands upward with a slow, steady forearm squeeze.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: An underhand pulldown that blends biceps and lat work, building strength through a joint-friendly pulling path.
exercises.instructions: Use an underhand shoulder-width grip, sit tall, and pull your shoulders down away from your ears; draw the bar toward your upper chest by pulling your elbows in front of you and down, pause, then return the bar overhead with control.

exercises.name: Ring Dip
exercises.description: Ring Dip is a vertical press that builds dense strength in your chest, shoulders, and triceps, targeting push, chest, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Support yourself on locked-out arms, lean slightly forward, then lower your shoulders below your elbows before driving powerfully back up, keeping the rings close to your sides.

exercises.name: Ring Muscle-Up
exercises.description: Ring Muscle-Up is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, full body while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Start in a false grip, pull explosively so the rings track close to your chest, then lean forward over your hands and press to lockout in a strong support position.

exercises.name: Ring Pull-up
exercises.description: A pull-up on free-moving rings that challenges shoulder stability and control while building powerful lats and arms.
exercises.instructions: Grip the rings and let them rotate naturally, engage your shoulders, and keep your body tight; pull your chest up between the rings, bringing them toward your ribs, then lower with control, maintaining a straight-line body position.

exercises.name: Ring Push-up
exercises.description: Ring Push-up is a pressing pattern that builds driving strength through your shoulders, chest, and arms, targeting push, chest, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Set the rings just off the floor, brace a rigid plank, then lower your chest between the rings and press back up, fighting to keep the rings from drifting out or shaking.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.description: Ring Row is a bodyweight pull that builds a strong back, solid grip, and tight core, targeting pull, upperback while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Hang under the rings with a straight body, pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows back, then lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully extended again.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip-dominant deadlift where you slide the bar down your thighs with soft knees, targeting your hamstrings and glutes through deep tension.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with the bar at your hips, soften your knees, and hinge by pushing your hips back while sliding the bar down your thighs; feel the stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand tall, keeping the bar close and your back flat.

exercises.name: Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.description: A wide‑grip push‑up variation that increases chest expansion and pressing power.
exercises.instructions: Face away from the cable, step one foot forward for balance, and bring the rope overhead with elbows tight to your head; straighten your arms to drive the rope forward and up, spreading the ends apart at the finish, then bend your elbows to return to the start.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.description: Full-body cardio on the rower where you drive through your legs and pull with your back and arms to build powerful, smooth endurance.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall on the seat, drive hard through your heels, extend your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs before reversing the motion with smooth, controlled strokes.

exercises.name: Run
exercises.description: A continuous, rhythmic gait that challenges your heart, lungs, and legs while building speed, stamina, and mental resilience.
exercises.instructions: Lean slightly forward from your ankles, land softly under your center of mass, keep your cadence quick and light, and relax your shoulders and hands as you move.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Russian Twist is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting rotation, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall, lean back slightly, lift your feet if able, and rotate your torso side to side while keeping your core tight.

exercises.name: Sandbag Clean
exercises.description: A sandbag lift from floor to front rack that builds brute strength, grip, and core stability with an awkward, real-world load.
exercises.instructions: Wrap your arms around the sandbag, drive through your heels and extend your hips, then roll the bag up your body to land on your chest or shoulders in a strong, upright stance.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges
exercises.description: A loaded lunge with a sandbag that challenges balance, leg strength, and core stability with an unstable, shifting load.
exercises.instructions: Hold the sandbag securely, step into a controlled lunge, drop your back knee toward the floor, and push through your front heel to return to standing without letting your torso collapse.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull Ups
exercises.description: A scapular pull‑up teaching shoulder‑blade control, improving pull‑up strength and posture.
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar with straight arms and a firm grip, keep your legs still, and pull your shoulders down and slightly back without bending your elbows; lift your body just a few centimeters as your chest rises toward the bar, pause in that shrug position, then relax back to a dead hang.

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.description: A supported row performed prone on a bench for pure, isolated back tension.
exercises.instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench elevated above the bar or dumbbells, arms hanging straight; row the weight up to touch or nearly touch the underside of the bench, squeeze your upper back hard, then lower until your arms are straight and your shoulders feel a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description: A bent-knee calf raise that targets the deeper soleus muscle, building thick, endurance-ready calves from the ground up.
exercises.instructions: Sit with knees bent, drive through the balls of your feet to lift your heels high, then lower slowly to stretch the calves.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Fly
exercises.description: A chest fly performed seated, helping you lock in posture and focus purely on opening and contracting your pecs.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall, bring the handles together with controlled chest tension, and return slowly without letting weights snap back.

exercises.name: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.description: A fly variation that stretches and contracts the chest in a wide circular path.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with your back against the pad and hands on the handles, elbows bent; push the handles down by extending your elbows until your arms are nearly straight, squeeze your triceps, then allow the weight to rise slowly while keeping your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: Seated Dip Press
exercises.description: A cable crossover pattern that loads your chest consistently from start to finish.
exercises.instructions: Sit with your feet planted and hands on the dip press handles, brace your core, and start with elbows bent; drive the handles down and slightly back by straightening your arms, pause at the bottom, then return with control while keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.description: Seated Hamstring Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, hamstrings, legs while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with one leg extended, hinge forward from your hips toward your toes, and reach your chest out rather than collapsing your head down, breathing into the back of your thigh.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.description: A machine curl where you pull your heels toward your glutes, isolating the hamstrings for focused strength through a safe, supported range.
exercises.instructions: Sit with the back pad supporting you, lock your thighs in place, and hook your heels under the pad; curl your heels down and back as far as you can, squeeze your hamstrings, then let the weight return slowly without your hips lifting.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.description: A cable row from a stable seated base, letting you focus on driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with a slight lean forward at the hips, grab the handle, and pull your shoulders down and back; row the handle toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close, pause to squeeze your back, then extend your arms fully before the next rep.

exercises.name: Seated Row V-grip
exercises.description: A close-grip seated row that hits the mid-back and lats, building compact, powerful pulling strength and a solid torso.
exercises.instructions: Hold the V-handle close, sit tall, and let your shoulders reach slightly forward for a stretch; pull the handle toward your navel, tucking your elbows close to your sides, then slowly extend your arms while staying braced through your core.

exercises.name: Seated Row Widegrip
exercises.description: A wide-grip seated row that widens your back, emphasizing rear delts and upper-back thickness with every controlled pull.
exercises.instructions: Grab the wide bar, sit tall with your chest lifted, and keep your shoulders pulled down; row the bar toward your upper abs or lower chest with flared elbows, focusing on spreading your chest and squeezing your mid-back, then return with control.

exercises.name: Shoulder CARs
exercises.description: Shoulder CARs is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, make a fist, and slowly draw your arm through a full pain-free circle, rotating at the shoulder as much as possible while keeping your ribs down and torso still.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.description: A one-arm lateral raise isolating each shoulder independently for balanced delt development and better mind-muscle control.
exercises.instructions: Sit or stand with the weights at shoulder height, palms forward, and brace your core; press straight up until your arms extend fully, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Shoulder Taps
exercises.description: A plank-based tap that trains anti-rotation strength and rock-solid core stability.
exercises.instructions: Start in a strong plank with hands under shoulders and feet slightly apart, squeeze your glutes and brace your core; lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder without letting your hips twist, then alternate sides in a smooth, controlled rhythm.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.description: A powerful shrug that builds trap height and upper‑back strength with each squeeze.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with the weights at your sides and your arms straight, draw your shoulders slightly back, then lift them straight up toward your ears as if trying to touch them; hold the squeeze at the top for a beat, then lower your shoulders all the way down without rolling them.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.description: Side Bend is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hold weight at your side, stand tall, and lean to one side by shortening your obliques, then return to center without twisting.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Side Plank is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Stack your feet, lift your hips, and keep your body in one straight line while pressing the floor away through your forearm.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Windmill
exercises.description: Side-Lying Windmill is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with knees stacked, reach both arms forward, then draw a big circle with your top arm, rotating your chest open while keeping your knees pinned together.

exercises.name: Single Arm Cable Row
exercises.description: A single‑arm cable row allowing precise lat focus and smooth, constant tension.
exercises.instructions: Stand or sit facing the cable with one hand on the handle and your torso square; pull the handle toward your lower ribs while rotating your shoulder blade back and down, pause for a squeeze, then let your arm extend fully without twisting your spine.

exercises.name: Single Arm Curl
exercises.description: A unilateral curl that lets you focus on one arm at a time, evening out strength imbalances and sharpening mind-muscle connection.
exercises.instructions: Brace your core, keep your elbow locked to your side, and curl the dumbbell smoothly through a full range without rotating your shoulder.

exercises.name: Single Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A one-arm pulldown that lets you focus on each side separately, smoothing out imbalances and sharpening mind-muscle connection.
exercises.instructions: Sit sideways or facing the cable, grab the handle with one hand, and keep your ribs down; pull your elbow toward your hip in a smooth arc, focusing on driving with your lat, then let your arm extend slowly without shrugging your shoulder.

exercises.name: Single Glute Bridge
exercises.description: A single-leg bridge that puts all the work on one side, sharpening glute activation and building balanced hip strength.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg extended, brace your abs, and drive through the working heel; lift your hips while keeping them level, pause to squeeze the glute at the top, then lower with full control.

exercises.name: Single Leg Extension
exercises.description: A toe-raised squat variation that shifts emphasis to the quads, building front-leg drive and knee stability.
exercises.instructions: Secure one leg under the pad, keep your hips squared and core tight, and extend the knee until the leg is straight; squeeze the top of your quad, then lower under control, keeping the motion slow and even on both sides.

exercises.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.description: A one-leg hip thrust that makes each glute work solo, improving balance, symmetry, and hip power with focused tension.
exercises.instructions: Set your upper back on a bench, plant one foot solidly on the ground, and extend the other leg in front of you; drive through the planted heel to lift your hips, keeping them level and squeezing the working glute at the top before lowering slowly.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: A single-leg calf raise that challenges your balance while building powerful, symmetrical lower legs one side at a time.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall on one leg, rise onto the ball of your foot, pause at the top, and lower slowly for full calf engagement.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A balancing hinge on one leg that lengthens the hamstrings and loads the glutes while your core fights to keep you steady.
exercises.instructions: Plant one foot and lightly bend the knee, hold the weight in the opposite hand, and hinge at the hips as your free leg reaches back; keep your hips square and spine long, then squeeze your standing glute to come back up.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.description: A forward-knee drive squat building quad strength and knee resilience through controlled deep knee flexion.
exercises.instructions: Rise onto your toes, squeeze your glutes, and lean your torso back as you bend your knees forward over your toes; lower as far as your control allows, then use your quads to pull yourself back up, keeping your hips extended.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.description: Sit-Up is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Anchor your feet or keep them free, reach forward as you roll up, and lower with control to keep tension in your core.

exercises.name: Skater Hop
exercises.description: Skater Hop is a side‑to‑side plyometric drill that builds agility, balance, and sharp single‑leg power, targeting push, full_body, full_body, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Push off one leg sideways, land softly on the opposite foot, sweep your trailing leg behind you, and keep your chest tall as you explode into the next lateral bound.

exercises.name: Ski Erg
exercises.description: A ski-style pulling motion where you drive handles down with hips, lats, and core to develop powerful, full-body conditioning.
exercises.instructions: Reach high with soft knees, then snap your hips, lats, and core down together as you pull the handles past your thighs, letting them glide back up under control.

exercises.name: Skinthe Cat
exercises.description: Skinthe Cat is a conditioning effort that drives your heart rate up while building repeatable endurance, targeting pull, shoulders, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: From a hang on the rings, pull your knees up and roll backward through your shoulders, then extend through the inverted hang before smoothly reversing the movement to come back through.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.description: A triceps‑focused extension where you lower the weight behind your head and press tall.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench with the bar or dumbbells held above your chest, elbows pointing toward the ceiling; bend only at the elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead or just behind it, then extend your arms again, squeezing your triceps at the top without letting your elbows flare out.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.description: A sled drag where you walk it back or forward under tension, building strong legs, lungs, and serious work capacity.
exercises.instructions: Attach the harness or straps, sit your hips back into an athletic stance, and brace your core; walk backward with controlled steps, driving through your legs and keeping constant tension on the straps as you pull the sled toward you.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.description: A forward drive where you lean into the sled and march it ahead, developing relentless leg drive, conditioning, and mental toughness.
exercises.instructions: Lean into the sled with straight arms, hips slightly back, and core tight; drive through the balls of your feet with powerful, short steps, keeping your body at a steady angle and the sled moving smoothly without jerky shoves.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.description: A full snatch with a deep catch that teaches you to pull fast, drop under the bar, and stand strong with powerful, coordinated legs.
exercises.instructions: Break the bar from the floor with tight lats, keep it close to your body, then pull yourself under to catch it in a deep overhead squat before standing up strong and stable.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
exercises.description: A wide-grip deadlift that forces a deeper hinge and more back engagement, building powerful legs, traps, and total pulling strength.
exercises.instructions: Take a wide snatch grip on the bar, drop your hips slightly, and lift your chest so your back is tight; push the floor away, keeping the bar close from shins to thighs, then stand tall while keeping your shoulders pulled back and down.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat
exercises.description: An anchored one-leg squat lowering fully to the ground, developing elite single-leg strength and mobility.
exercises.instructions: Anchor a strap or band behind your knees, sit back into it like a sling, and drop into a deep squat; keep your torso upright, knees driven forward against the band, and push through your entire foot to stand while maintaining tension.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description: A face-down curl over a bench, forcing strict form and constant tension so your biceps do all the work.
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, let arms hang freely, then curl straight up focusing on a strong peak contraction.

exercises.name: Spiderman
exercises.description: Spiderman is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: From a plank, step one foot outside your hand, drop your hips, and return, alternating legs with smooth, controlled motion.

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.description: An explosive dip-and-drive into a split stance that teaches you to launch weight overhead while landing stable and balanced.
exercises.instructions: With the bar on your shoulders, take a small dip, then explosively drive it overhead as you split your feet, landing with a soft front knee and stable back leg before recovering your stance.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.description: A stationary split squat that builds single-leg strength, stability, and balanced hip power.
exercises.instructions: Set your feet in a split stance, drop your back knee straight down toward the floor, and keep most of your weight on the front leg; stay tall through your torso and push through the front heel to come back up.

exercises.name: Squat Row
exercises.description: A combo move where you sit into a shallow squat then row to your torso, training powerful legs and a strong upper back in one pattern.
exercises.instructions: Sit your hips back into a shallow squat as you reach forward to the cable, brace your core, and keep your chest proud; hold the squat as you pull the handle toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms before standing back up.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.description: A continuous climbing pattern that mimics stairs, building powerful legs, strong lungs, and real-world uphill endurance.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, place your entire foot on each step, press through your heel to rise, and keep your hands light on the rails instead of hanging your body weight on them.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: A tall, upright calf raise that loads your calves through a full stretch and squeeze for strong, defined lower legs.
exercises.instructions: Keep legs straight but not locked, push through the balls of your feet, lift tall, and lower under full control.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend
exercises.description: Standing Side Bend is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with feet under hips, reach one arm overhead, and gently arc your torso to the opposite side, lengthening through your fingertips without collapsing your chest.

exercises.name: Step- Upto Press
exercises.description: A step onto a box that finishes with a strong overhead press, training single-leg strength, balance, and shoulder power together.
exercises.instructions: Place your whole foot on the box, drive through your heel to stand tall on top, then press the weight overhead before stepping down under control.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.description: A forward knee drive that strengthens your quads and improves knee health by working through controlled forward travel.
exercises.instructions: Face the box, plant your whole foot firmly on top, and lean your torso slightly forward over the working leg; drive through that heel to stand tall on the box without bouncing off the back leg, then lower yourself down with control.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.description: A straight-leg style deadlift that keeps your knees only slightly bent, stretching and loading the hamstrings through a long hinge.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with the bar at your thighs, keep your knees only slightly bent, and hinge by pushing your hips back; lower the bar down your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, then pull your hips forward to return to standing.

exercises.name: Stir-the-Pot
exercises.description: Stir-the-Pot is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: From a plank on a stability ball, draw slow circles with your forearms while keeping your body perfectly still.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A straight-armed cable pull from overhead that teaches your lats to fire hard without bending your elbows, carving out a strong back.
exercises.instructions: Stand facing the cable with arms straight and the bar overhead, hinge slightly at the hips, and lock your ribs down; pull the bar in an arc toward your thighs by driving from your lats, keeping your elbows nearly straight, then let the bar rise under control to stretch your lats again.

exercises.name: Strict Handstand Push-Up
exercises.description: Strict Handstand Push-Up is a pressing pattern that builds driving strength through your shoulders, chest, and arms, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Start in a tight, wall-supported handstand, slowly lower under control until your head lightly taps the floor, then press back up without using any leg drive.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.description: A one-sided carry that forces your core to resist tipping toward the weight, building anti-tilt strength and everyday stability.
exercises.instructions: Hold a single weight by your side like a suitcase, brace your core so you don't lean, and let your free arm swing naturally; walk in a straight line with deliberate steps, staying tall and resisting any tilt toward the load.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: A wide-stance pull from the floor where you push your feet out and stand tall, targeting hips and glutes for powerful lower-body strength.
exercises.instructions: Take a wide stance with toes turned out and grip the bar inside your knees; drive your feet into the floor, push your knees out, and stand by squeezing your glutes and bringing your hips toward the bar without overextending your lower back.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat to a box that builds unilateral strength, balance, and hip control.
exercises.instructions: Take a wide stance with toes turned out, push your knees out to follow your toes, and drop your hips straight down; keep your chest open, weight centered, and drive the floor apart with your feet as you rise.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: A prone back extension where you lift your arms and legs off the floor, building lower-back endurance and full-body posterior strength.
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with arms straight overhead, brace your core, and lift your chest, arms, and legs as if you're flying; squeeze your glutes and lower back, then lower with control without letting your limbs slam to the floor.

exercises.name: Support Hold (Rings)
exercises.description: Support Hold (Rings) is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, chest, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Press the rings down, lock your elbows, and lift your body so your shoulders sit above your hands, squeezing your glutes and ribs together to stay tall and still.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.description: A low-impact, full-body cardio exercise in the water that strengthens your back, shoulders, and core while improving breathing control.
exercises.instructions: Keep your body long and horizontal, pull the water past your hips with each stroke, and kick from the hips in a steady rhythm while turning your head just enough to breathe.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description: A landmine or handle row that builds thick lats and strong rotational control.
exercises.instructions: Stand over the T-bar with a slight bend in your knees and a strong hip hinge, chest lifted; pull the handle toward your lower chest or upper stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower the weight until your arms are straight and your lats feel stretched.

exercises.name: Tempo Back Squat
exercises.description: A narrow-stance squat that trains quad dominance and tight, controlled lower-body mechanics.
exercises.instructions: Lower into your squat with a slow three-to-five-second descent, keeping your chest up and knees tracking out; briefly hold the bottom if programmed, then drive up powerfully while maintaining your brace.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.description: Thread the Needle is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting pull, back while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: From all fours, slide one arm underneath your body, resting your shoulder and head on the floor, then gently twist your torso to feel a stretch between your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Thruster
exercises.description: A front squat directly into a forceful overhead press that demands leg drive, core stability, and shoulder strength in one continuous move.
exercises.instructions: Start with the bar at your shoulders, sink into a full front squat, then explode upward and let that leg drive carry the bar into a strong overhead press in one fluid movement.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.description: An upright ankle dorsiflexion drill that targets your tibialis to improve knee health, ankle strength, and lower-leg durability.
exercises.instructions: Stand with your back against a wall or machine, keep your knees slightly bent, and pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can; pause at the top, feeling the front of your lower legs light up, then lower your feet under control.

exercises.name: Toes-to- Bar
exercises.description: A hanging core raise where you lift your legs to touch the bar, building powerful abs, hip flexors, and total-body control.
exercises.instructions: Hang from the bar, pull into a hollow position, then snap your hips and lift your legs to touch your toes to the bar before lowering them with control.

exercises.name: Toetouch
exercises.description: Toetouch is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised, lift your shoulders and reach for your toes, focusing on curling your ribs toward your pelvis.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.description: A neutral-grip deadlift performed inside a trap bar, letting you sit between the handles for powerful leg and hip strength with less strain.
exercises.instructions: Step inside the trap bar, grab the handles, and sit your hips down until your chest is proud and your back neutral; press through your whole foot to stand up, letting the handles travel straight up and down like elevator rails.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
exercises.description: A controlled run on the treadmill that lets you dial in pace, incline, and technique to steadily build running capacity and form.
exercises.instructions: Set a slight incline, keep your gaze forward, run with short, quick steps, and avoid overstriding or holding the rails so your form stays natural.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.description: A bodyweight pushing move where you lower and drive up between bars, building thick triceps, strong shoulders, and chest strength.
exercises.instructions: Lower your body by bending your elbows straight back, then press up strongly while keeping your shoulders down.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension
exercises.description: A band‑resisted press offering joint‑friendly chest activation and smooth resistance.
exercises.instructions: Lie on a bench or stand with the cable or dumbbells held out in front, elbows fixed in place; bend only at the elbows to lower the weight, then extend your arms, squeezing the triceps at the end of each rep without letting your shoulders roll forward.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension Single Arm
exercises.description: A push‑up that emphasizes chest and core engagement through a controlled descent.
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell or cable handle with one hand, fix your upper arm in place, and bend only at the elbow; extend until your arm is straight and your triceps are fully engaged, then lower under control before switching sides.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
exercises.description: A single‑arm push‑up variation challenging core stability and unilateral strength.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at the hips with your upper arm glued to your side and elbow bent at 90 degrees; extend your arm straight back until the dumbbell is in line with your torso, squeeze the back of your arm, then return to the starting bend without swinging your shoulder.

exercises.name: Triceps Overhead Stretch
exercises.description: Triceps Overhead Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, triceps, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Reach one arm overhead, bend the elbow so your hand drops between your shoulder blades, then gently pull the elbow back with your other hand as you lift your chest and breathe.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.description: An angled dumbbell press that targets upper chest with a strong, controlled push.
exercises.instructions: Stand facing the cable with your elbows tucked to your ribs and a firm grip on the bar or rope; press the handle straight down until your arms are fully extended, squeeze your triceps hard at the bottom, then let the handle rise back up only until your forearms are parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown Single Arm
exercises.description: A flat dumbbell press building full‑chest strength with a wide, stable range of motion.
exercises.instructions: Grab the single handle with your palm facing down or in, glue your elbow to your side, and stand tall; extend your arm until it's straight without swinging your shoulder, pause to feel the triceps, then control the handle back up to about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Tuck Planche Hold (Parallettes)
exercises.description: Tuck Planche Hold (Parallettes) is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Lean your shoulders forward over your hands, lift your feet off the ground, and tuck your knees toward your chest while keeping locked elbows and a rounded, tight midline.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
exercises.description: A full-body get-up with a weight held overhead that trains shoulder stability, core strength, and total-body control from floor to stand.
exercises.instructions: Move deliberately: punch the kettlebell to the ceiling, roll to your elbow then hand, bridge and sweep your leg back, rise to a lunge, and stand tall under the weight before reversing each step.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.description: A high pull to collarbone height that drives shoulder and trap development.
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar or dumbbells in front of your thighs with a close grip, pull your shoulders down and back, then drive your elbows straight up along your body; lift until your elbows reach about shoulder height, pause, and slowly lower without shrugging excessively.

exercises.name: V-up
exercises.description: V-up is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Lift your legs and torso simultaneously, reaching for your toes to form a V shape, then lower in one smooth line.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.description: A sharp jackknife motion where hands and feet meet in the middle, powerfully targeting your abs and hip flexors in one crisp snap.
exercises.instructions: Lie long with arms overhead, then simultaneously lift your legs and torso, reaching your hands toward your toes to form a sharp V before lowering under control.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.description: A low-intensity, joint-friendly movement where you stride tall and relaxed to boost daily activity, circulation, and basic endurance.
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with relaxed shoulders, step smoothly from heel to toe, swing your arms naturally, and keep a comfortable, steady pace you can maintain.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: A forward-striding lunge that challenges balance and leg power with each step, building strong quads, glutes, and hips.
exercises.instructions: Step forward with a long stride, plant your front heel, and drop your back knee toward the floor; keep your torso tall, drive through the front leg, and smoothly step into the next lunge like you're moving along a track.

exercises.name: Walking Lungewith Twist
exercises.description: A forward lunge paired with a torso twist that builds leg strength, hip mobility, and core control in a walking pattern.
exercises.instructions: Step forward into a long lunge, lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, then rotate your torso over the front leg before driving through that heel into the next step.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.description: A squat-to-throw movement where you drop into depth and launch the ball to the target, building power, endurance, and coordination.
exercises.instructions: Face the target, hold the ball at your chest, drop into a full squat, then drive up and use your legs to launch the ball to the mark, catching it as you flow straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.description: A static wall hold where you sit into a squat against the wall, building isometric quad strength and iron mental resilience.
exercises.instructions: Slide your back down the wall until your knees are at about 90 degrees, stack your knees over your ankles, and press your lower back gently into the wall; keep your chest proud, weight in your heels, and hold strong without resting your hands on your thighs.

exercises.name: Wall Slides
exercises.description: Wall Slides is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, shoulders, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Stand with your back, head, and arms against the wall in a goalpost shape, then slide your hands overhead and back down, keeping your lower ribs flat and arms in contact the whole time.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
exercises.description: Wall Walk is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, shoulders, full body while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Start in a prone push-up position with feet on the wall, then step your hands back and feet up the wall, climbing until your chest faces the wall before carefully walking back down.

exercises.name: Weighted Plank
exercises.description: Weighted Plank is a focused athletic movement designed to build strength, control, and efficient mechanics, targeting push, abdominals, core, keeping your movement sharp and your effort intentional.
exercises.instructions: Hold a rigid plank while maintaining tension from shoulders to heels, resisting sagging under the added load.

exercises.name: Weighted Push-up
exercises.description: A loaded push-up where you add resistance to your back, turning a simple push-up into a serious strength and muscle builder.
exercises.instructions: Maintain perfect push-up form while resisting added weight, lowering slowly and pressing explosively.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.description: World's Greatest Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, full body while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Step into a deep lunge, drop your back knee, place your opposite hand by your front foot, then rotate your chest and reach your free arm toward the ceiling before switching sides.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.description: A focused forearm curl where you flex your wrists to build strong gripping muscles and better bar and handle control.
exercises.instructions: Rest forearms on a bench, curl your palm upward with full range, and lower slowly for strong forearm activation.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension
exercises.description: A forearm move where you raise the back of the hand against resistance, strengthening the muscles that stabilize your wrists.
exercises.instructions: Hold the weight palms down, lift the back of your hand upward, and lower slowly to strengthen forearms.

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
exercises.description: Wrist Extensor Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, other, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Reach one arm forward palm down, curl your fingers toward the floor, and lightly pull them in with your other hand while keeping your elbow straight to target the top of your forearm.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: Wrist Flexor Stretch is a focused strength movement that challenges your muscles and control through the full range, targeting push, other, arms while keeping your technique sharp and your effort high.
exercises.instructions: Extend one arm in front of you palm up, gently pull your fingers down and back with the opposite hand, and straighten your elbow to open the underside of your forearm.

exercises.name: Y Raise
exercises.description: A shoulder raise forming a Y shape overhead, training your upper back and rotator cuff for better posture and shoulder stability.
exercises.instructions: Hinge at your hips, raise your arms in a Y shape, and keep your shoulder blades pulled down to target the upper back.

exercises.name: Z Press
exercises.description: A reverse fly motion targeting the rear delts and upper back, improving shoulder balance and stability.
exercises.instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, brace your core, and hold the bar at shoulder height; without leaning back, press the bar straight overhead until your biceps reach your ears, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.description: A front-loaded arm-carry squat that forces upright posture, loading your quads and core with intense front-body tension.
exercises.instructions: Cradle the bar in the crook of your elbows, keep it close to your body, and brace your core hard; sit your hips down between your heels, let your knees track out, then drive back up while keeping the bar glued to your torso.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
exercises.description: A curl that rotates from palm-up to palm-down, building biceps on the way up and powerful forearms on the way down.
exercises.instructions: Curl the weights palms-up, rotate your wrists at the top, then lower palms-down to hit both biceps and forearms with control.
